# Configuration: assistants, packs, profiles, versions

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/config`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/config.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/flags` | Feature flags evaluated for the caller's tenant (Studio and widget read these). |  | 200 list of `FlagOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/kinds` | All configuration kinds with JSON Schemas (including x-ui hints for generated forms). |  | 200 list of `KindInfo` |
| `GET` | `/v1/objects` | List Objects |  | 200 list of `ObjectOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/objects` | Create Object | `ObjectCreate` | 201 `ObjectOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}` | Get Object |  | 200 `ObjectOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}` | Archive Object |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/deployments/history` | Deployment History |  | 200 list of `HistoryOut` |
| `PUT` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/deployments/{environment}` | Deploy or promote a published version. | `DeployIn` | 200 object |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/deployments/{environment}` | Undeploy |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/diff` | Structural diff between two versions (Studio shows it next to the evaluation score diff). |  | 200 object |
| `PUT` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/draft` | Save Draft | `DraftIn` | 200 `VersionDetail` |
| `GET` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/versions/{version}` | Get Version |  | 200 `VersionDetail` |
| `POST` | `/v1/objects/{kind}/{name}/versions/{version}/publish` | Publish a draft. | application/json | 200 `PublishOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/packs/gallery` | Ready-made Domain Packs to start from, and whether each is live in dev already. |  | 200 list of `GalleryPack` |
| `POST` | `/v1/packs/gallery/{name}/install` | Import a ready-made pack, publish it and make it live in dev, in one step. |  | 200 `VersionOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/packs/import` | Import a Domain Pack YAML file. | string | 201 `VersionDetail` |
| `GET` | `/v1/packs/{name}/export` | Export Pack |  | 200 |
| `GET` | `/v1/profiles/{kind}` | Profiles of a kind usable in an environment (built-in and deployed), for Studio pickers. |  | 200 list of object |
| `GET` | `/v1/resolve/agents/{name}` | The agent as the runtime will see it. |  | 200 object |
| `GET` | `/v1/resolve/objects/{kind}/{name}` | The version of an object deployed in an environment (e.g. |  | 200 `DeployedObject` |
| `GET` | `/v1/resolve/profiles/{kind}/{name}` | Effective model/retrieval/retention profile for the data plane, with floors applied. |  | 200 object |
| `GET` | `/v1/snapshots/{environment}` | Signed bundle of everything deployed in an environment, pulled by data planes. |  | 200 |
| `GET` | `/v1/vocabulary` | Domain terms per locale from the packs deployed in an environment (Studio and widget labels). |  | 200 object |
